Messages.Author: Oortje
Messages.Body:
Hi,

I couldnt find the awnser to my question right away so here it is..
When i play final loosening as auspex card. Can i play it on a gaints blood? Since there is no action can i play a reaction? or does the 'Play when the acting vampire would gain 1 or more blood" part allow me to play it at any time when blood is gained?
And what happens when someone uses heidelberg to move blood? is it gained by the receiving vampire?

Final Loosening
Reaction

Auspex
Dementation
Fortitude
Requires an anarch.
aus: Play when the acting vampire would gain 1 or more blood. The acting vampire and this reacting anarch each gain 1 blood instead.
dem: Gain 4 votes.
for: Only usable when an ally is acting. The action fails and the ally takes 1 damage. Tap this reacting anarch.

Thanks in advance for the awnser.
Oortje

Have a cold long night,
Jeroen van Oort
Dutch National Coördinator

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
It's a reaction. You need an action to be able to use a reaction ; so, Giant blood cannot be affected, nor can be the use of Lillith Blessing or the use of any Hunting Ground.

If a reaction is playable without action, it is alway written on the card. Rewind time is the only example I can think of.

Rewind Time

[Reaction] Reaction

[Temporis] Temporis
[2 Blood]
[TEM] Usable by a ready, untapped vampire even though there is no action. Cancel a non-out-of-turn master card as it is played during any other Methuselah's master phase (no cost is paid). The Methuselah who played that card gains another master phase action.

www.secretlibrary.info/index.php?lib=1055

Please note that the action does not have to make the vampire gain blood : you can play Final loosening on a blood gain done by an action modifier, or by tapping The Coven.

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body: Additionally, Heidelberg is not used during actions (by explciit card text). So there's no action, so you can't play a reaction.

Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body: Also note that you cannot play it on a Taste of Vitae because non-combat cards cannot be played during a combat.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body: Correct answers from Ohlmann, jamesatzephyr and Boris the Blade.
